companies.name: 365 Response
companies.description: 365 Response provides cloud-based software solutions for public and private transport services, supporting thousands of journeys annually.

companies.name: A Wilderness Way
companies.description: A Wilderness Way provides high-acuity residential care and crisis intervention services for vulnerable young people.

companies.name: Amdaris
companies.description: Amdaris is a software developer and digital transformation specialist that used growth capital from BGF to fund its international expansion.

companies.name: Arcinova
companies.description: Arcinova is a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO), supporting the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors.

companies.name: Brindley Healthcare
companies.description: Headquartered in County Donegal, BGF-backed Brindley Healthcare is one of Ireland’s largest privately-owned nursing home groups.

companies.name: TCC Group
companies.description: As experts in FCA regulation, culture and conduct risk, TCC Group provides support on regulatory and compliance issues to global banks and the wider financial services sector.

companies.name: Abselion
companies.description: BGF-backed Abselion develops award-winning automated analytical instrumentation, to simplify at-line protein quantification for scientists.

companies.name: Acro
companies.description: Acro Aircraft Seating designs and manufactures economy airline seats for the low-cost carrier market. Its range includes both fixed and reclining seats, as well as premium economy seats.

companies.name: Action24
companies.description: Action24 is a security business which provides monitored intruder alarms, CCTV and access control solutions to households and businesses across Ireland. Action serves over 13,000 customers from its state-of-the-art monitoring alarm monitoring facility in Dublin.

companies.name: ADEPT4 plc
companies.description: Adept4 delivers IT-as-a-Service (ITaaS) to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK. ITaaS provides customers with exactly the amount of technology to support their business needs, billed on a monthly basis, based on what is consumed.

companies.name: Anstey Horne
companies.description:
Anstey Horne is the UK’s leading specialist Rights of Light, Daylight & Sunlight, Party Wall, Building Consultancy & Fire Consultancy practice.
With roots dating back to 1790, the firm is made up of experts, combining leading opinion, insight & technology with over 200 years of expertise. The business works with clients across the whole of the UK from offices in London, Birmingham, Manchester, Bri

companies.name: Antser
companies.description: Antser delivers transformational solutions to the health, education and social care sectors, in partnership with local authority and independent providers. Its solutions range from direct work with children and core compliance to transformation, training and technology all with one aim in mind – to deliver better outcomes.

companies.name: Apprentify
companies.description: Alderley Park-headquartered Apprentify specialises in digital marketing, social media and tech courses, enabling employers to recruit and train apprentices skilled ‘for the jobs of tomorrow’.

companies.name: APSU
companies.description: APSU delivers IBM solutions, with services covering technical consultancy, managed services, cloud hosting and physical co-location.

companies.name: Arborea
companies.description: Arborea is a technology business that has developed a breakthrough cultivation platform for photosynthetic microorganisms for use as food ingredients and proteins. It was founded by CEO Julian Melchiorri in 2015, following his research at Imperial College London.

companies.name: Arc Inspirations
companies.description: ARC Inspirations is a high performing, commercially successful bar group in the North of England operating 3 brands with 18 venues in total. ARC lives to inspire our teams to bring our guests the best drinks, food and to create memorable experiences for them in our venues for all occasions.

companies.name: Artisanal Spirits Company
companies.description: The Artisanal Spirits Company (ASC) is the owner of The Scotch Malt Whisky Society (SMWS), the leading curator and provider of premium single cask Scotch malt whisky to a global customer base of subscribers. Founded in 1983, SMWS commands a membership of 28,000 members, across 30 countries.

companies.name: ARuVR
companies.description: ARuVR is the world’s first turnkey extended reality (XR) SaaS platform that puts the power of content creation, distribution, and management directly into the hands of the user allowing businesses to develop and deploy at-scale their own Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) learning experience, with minimal training and in a matter of minutes.

companies.name: Aubin
companies.description: Aubin Group is globally recognised as a leading developer and supplier of chemical solutions to the oil and gas industry with manufacturing, stocking and office locations in the UK, USA and various regions in the Middle East.

companies.name: Aubren
companies.description: Aubren designs and makes products in collaboration with innovators in the air handling, cleantech and meditech sectors and manufacturers who require air handling components.

companies.name: Ballpark
companies.description: Ballpark is a creativity and collaboration tool for businesses to capture feedback on marketing copy, designs, prototypes, and more.

companies.name: BBC Maestro
companies.description: BBC Maestro is a subscription-based streaming platform, created to educate and inspire people to explore their creativity. Through pre-recorded lessons and detailed course notes, anyone can learn a wide range of disciplines and follow in the footsteps of experts respected all over the world.

companies.name: Bella & Duke
companies.description: Bella & Duke was founded in 2016 by Mark Scott and Tony Ottley – two friends who agreed that existing mainstream pet food products did not give dogs and cats the best chance of enjoying long, healthy lives. Bella & Duke’s raw, natural petfood provides notable health benefits to pets, with over 92% of customers reporting an improvement in their dog within 8 weeks.

companies.name: BHR Group
companies.description: BHR Group provides engineering consultancy, industrial research and product development services related to fluids engineering.

companies.name: BigBlu Broadband plc
companies.description: BigBlu Broadband, formerley Satellite Solutions Worldwide, is a global communications company specialising in rural, last-mile and emergency communications, via satellite, to anywhere on the planet.

companies.name: BioCity Group
companies.description: BioCity is the UK’s largest life science incubation business, providing specialist workspace for growing life science companies, including access to high-end equipment, shared services and training, as well as business advice through its expert network.

companies.name: Bloom Procurement
companies.description: Bloom Procurement was founded in 2011 by the executive chairman, Adam Jacobs and has a unique proposition as the only independent marketplace for the public sector to buy and manage contracts. Bloom compliantly awards public sector contracts to its dynamic supplier base across a wide range of professional service categories.

companies.name: Blue Light Card
companies.description: Blue Light Card develops a tech-enabled, closed group, discount market place and omnichannel marketing solution for its Retailer Partners. It brings thousands of preferential discounts to verified members in the NHS, Emergency Services, Armed Forces and Social Care.

companies.name: Blue-i Group
companies.description: Blue-i Group delivers state-of-the-art AV, set and stage asset hire, coupled with technical and project management services, for the live events and theatre industries.

companies.name: Bob & Berts
companies.description: Known for its quality offering and community-focused approach, Bob & Berts operates a chain of coffee shops across Northern Ireland, Scotland and England, with plans to grow to 100 sites by 2030.

companies.name: Boxphish
companies.description: Boxphish develops a human risk management platform to help organisations mitigate the risk of falling victim to cyber attacks.

companies.name: Broadband Satellite Services
companies.description: BSS (the parent company of Satcom Global) is a top tier distributor of satellite communications services to organisations requiring communications in remote environments where mainstream terrestrial networks are not available.

companies.name: Brownhills Glass
companies.description: Brownhills specialises in bespoke glass processing according to the specifications of architects, builders, interior designers and private home owners, in addition to providing glass merchanting services to independent DGU manufacturers.

companies.name: BSE Group
companies.description: BSE Group is a specialist tax consultancy, made up of three subsidiary companies: RDS (R&D specialists), CAS (capital allowance specialists) and LRS (land remediation specialists).

companies.name: BWP Group
companies.description: BGF-backed BWP Group is an award-winning, integrated destination marketing agency, helping drive people to places and spaces for its clients.

companies.name: Calnex Solutions
companies.description: Calnex designs and makes equipment that tests the performance of telecom network infrastructure for customers including BT, Ericsson, Nokia and Facebook. To date, Calnex has secured and delivered orders from over 600 customer sites, in 68 countries across the world.

companies.name: Cambridge Energy
companies.description: Cambridge Energy (previously Cambridge Energy Partners) manufactures pre-fabricated, re-deployable, solar tracker systems, with a focus on commercial and industrial markets.

companies.name: Campion Homes
companies.description: Campion Homes is a family-owned Scottish housebuilder of both private residential and affordable homes. Since 1989, the company has build homes across Fife, the Lothians, Clackmannanshire and Perth.

companies.name: Celaton
companies.description: BGF-backed Celaton develops Intelligent Document Processing software for business processes, such as sales orders and client correspondence.

companies.name: Celerity
companies.description: Celerity is a fast-growing provider of high value, complex hybrid cloud and IT managed services. The business leads organisations through digital transformation and modernisation to deliver greater efficiency in management and optimisation of critical enterprise infrastructure. Its services include cyber security, data recovery and data visualisation.

companies.name: Cennox
companies.description: Launched by former Travelex director Clive Nation in 2006, Cennox provides ATM and branch transformation services to the world's leading banks, retail and commercial institutions.

companies.name: CHS Healthcare
companies.description: CHS Healthcare is the country’s leading provider in hospital discharge services. Founded in 1995 by Dr Richard Newland, CHS has contracts with more than 60 NHS hospitals and clinical commissioning groups, from the south coast and London, up to the north of England.

companies.name: Cirrus
companies.description: As contact centre specialists selling exclusively through the channel, Cirrus partners with ambitious companies to help their customers achieve flawless customer experience. Cirrus contact centre delivers a seamless omnichannel experience for both customers and agents, connecting interactions together across channels such as voice, video, email, messaging and social media, achieving a single view

companies.name: Clearway Group
companies.description: The Clearway Group is a vacant property services business, providing technology-led solutions, including alarms and CCTV to monitor and secure properties.

companies.name: Click Travel
companies.description: Click Travel is the UK's fastest-growing business travel management company. It manages millions of travel bookings a year for a wide variety of businesses from the FTSE 100 to the public and third sector. It also offers the travel.cloud platform on a SaaS (Software as a Service) basis for SMEs and businesses who don’t want to be tied to a contract.

companies.name: CMS
companies.description: BGF-backed Collision Management Systems (CMS) is a SaaS business that uses algorithms to digest and refine data from any telematics device.

companies.name: Connected Health
companies.description: BGF-backed Connected Health is Ireland’s largest privately-owned homecare provider, delivering personalised, tech-enhanced care services.

companies.name: Cooplands
companies.description: Founded in 1885, the fourth-generation company delivers traditionally-made, high-quality produce including breads, sandwiches, pies, pasties and cakes to more than 140 Cooplands shops, 11 cafes and 28 sandwich vans.

companies.name: Cornwall Insight
companies.description: Cornwall Insight provides research, analysis, consultancy and training across the energy and water sectors. The Norwich-headquartered company helps customers understand the implications of policy, regulation and market change on business operations.

companies.name: Croom Precision Medical
companies.description: Croom Precision Medical is a precision engineering business which specialises in designing and manufacturing precision components for the medical device industry. The company was set up in 1984, and focuses on the machining and handling of precious metals for use in a sterile environment.

companies.name: CSN Care Group
companies.description: The CSN Care Group is a leading national domiciliary care provider with head offices in Milton Keynes and Edinburgh. CSN provides quality, personalised home care services designed to enable our customers to remain as independent as possible within their own home, safely, comfortably, and with dignity.

companies.name: CurrentBody
companies.description: CurrentBody is the world's largest supplier of beauty devices. Its product range includes anti-ageing and acne treatment devices, facial cleansers, and hair removal devices, incorporating clinically-proven technologies as they found a niche in providing professional results at home.

companies.name: Cussins
companies.description: BGF partnered with Cussins in December 2014, providing a £5m investment to support new site acquisition and housing developments.

companies.name: Datum360
companies.description: Founded in 2009, the Teesside-based connected data company Datum360 has grown to have a global footprint. It was acquired by Autodesk in 2024.

companies.name: ONYX
companies.description: ONYX (the commercial arm of Burrington Business Parks) is one of the leading industrial and commercial developers in the region, building high-quality, flexible and sustainable business units for small to medium-sized businesses across the South West of England.

companies.name: Cyted
companies.description: Cyted is a medical diagnostics company, that develops an innovative platform (combining a non-invasive test with data-driven biomarkers) for early detection and risk stratification of cancers and inflammatory diseases. Its first application is in the early detection of esophageal cancer for patients in primary and community care.

companies.name: Decision Tech
companies.description: Decision Tech (now part of Moneysupermarket.com) is a market leading business in price comparison for home communications. In addition to operating broadbandchoices.co.uk, the company provides the technology, data and performance analytics powering telecoms comparison on major brands including Moneysavingexpert.com.

companies.name: Decora
companies.description: Decora is an established leader in the design, engineering, manufacturing and distribution of window coverings across the UK and Ireland. The business has invested heavily in its manufacturing capacity and produces a market-leading range of standardised and bespoke window coverings, including blinds and shutters.

companies.name: DevOpsGroup
companies.description: DevOpsGroup empowers digital transformation through high-performing IT capabilities for enterprises, including ASOS, Admiral Insurance, BAE Systems, and Vodafone, and scaleup companies.

companies.name: Dianomi
companies.description: Dianomi’s propriety platform matches premium sponsored content with relevant audiences, while maintaining brand protection and improving return on investment. Its native content marketing platform is used by financial advertisers and tier one publishers.

companies.name: DICE
companies.description: Dice is a mobile ticketing and live-music tracking app. Every feature of the app is designed to bring users closer to the music they love. Once tickets are purchased, they are locked into the buyer's account, stopping touts and protecting fans and artists from paying over the odds.

companies.name: Duncan and Todd
companies.description: Duncan and Todd owns and operates a chain of opticians in Scotland, with shops stretching from Fife to the Highlands. The business also manufactures its own lenses at its laboratory in North East Scotland.

companies.name: Echion Technologies
companies.description: Echion is a world-leading developer of advanced lithium-ion battery materials, whose products enable cell manufacturers to deliver cost-effective, fast-charging, high-energy density and long-life power cells for a wide range of markets (including automotive, transportation, premium consumer electronics, and grid-storage applications).

companies.name: Edgescan
companies.description: Edgesan is a cybersecurity software and services business which specialises in vulnerability management. Its proprietary SaaS product continuously detects vulnerabilities across a company’s networks, web applications, API’s and cloud deployments and provides real time vulnerability intelligence to support the efficient remediation of detected risks.

companies.name: Elasmogen
companies.description: Elasmogen is a privately held biopharmaceutical company located in the thriving biologics cluster in Aberdeen, Scotland. The Company is rapidly progressing a pipeline of next-generation soloMER products for the treatment solid-tumour cancers, systemic inflammatory diseases and inflammatory conditions of the gut.

companies.name: Eleven
companies.description: BGF-backed Eleven is a global leader in sports marketing and community-driven partnerships across the highest level of professional sport.

companies.name: Emma Bridgewater
companies.description: Founded in 1984, Emma Bridgewater designs and manufactures hand-decorated pottery and a wide selection of home products. Its products are handmade in a renovated 19th Century factory in Stoke-on-Trent and are sold through its website, own stores, as well as wholesale customers such as John Lewis and Next.

companies.name: Environmental Essentials
companies.description: Environmental Essentials provides key compliance services, including asbestos management, water hygiene, and fire risk management.

companies.name: Equilaw
companies.description: Set up in 2007, Equilaw is the UK’s only dedicated equity release legal adviser, working with homeowners and financial advisers to provide independent legal advice on the process of releasing home equity for a range of purposes, including retirement planning, house improvements and care provision.

companies.name: ER Productions
companies.description: Backed by BGF since 2024, ER Productions is an award-winning laser production, pyrotechnics and special effects specialist.

companies.name: European Braking Systems
companies.description: EBS manufactures and distributes a range of component systems including friction, brake discs, complete brake systems including ABS and EBS designed to improve braking responsiveness and safety.

companies.name: Eventmaster
companies.description: BGF-backed Eventmaster develops ticketing, membership registration, and fundraising software solutions for large-scale events.

companies.name: Evo Dental
companies.description: Using the latest hi-tech medical technology, Evo Dental provides life changing treatment for patients suffering from severe dental problems caused by advanced gum disease, congenital bone loss or accidents, and who require a full jaw reconstruction.

companies.name: Evolution Aqua
companies.description: Evolution Aqua is a designer, manufacturer and supplier of a wide range of water filtration products and associated equipment, primarily focused on the aquatics industry for both indoor and outdoor fish care.

companies.name: Evolve
companies.description: BGF-backed Evolve provides end-to-end managed network and IT solutions, to businesses in a range of sectors, including retail and hospitality.

companies.name: Firefly Learning
companies.description: Firefly Learning is an edtech business with an online tool for teachers to set homework, create resources, and track student progress.

companies.name: FluoRok
companies.description: BGF-backed startup FluoRok has developed an innovative method for safe and environmentally friendly access to fluorochemicals.

companies.name: Four Communications
companies.description: Four Communications is an independent communications agency. Its key services include public relations, public affairs, marketing, sponsorship, digital content as well as media planning & buying with a particular focus on the property, travel, culture, healthcare, financial services and public sectors.

companies.name: Frontrow
companies.description: The Frontrow team has acquired, established and grown a group of energy service companies, creating a hub for the development of exciting new technologies and providing entrepreneurial teams with operational guidance and expertise.

companies.name: Furniture Village
companies.description: Furniture Village is a major UK retailer of leading sofa and bed brands, selling through its stores and growing online presence. Positioned at the top end of the volume furniture market, its product range is largely sourced from the within the UK.

companies.name: Gaist
companies.description: Gaist captures and analyses continuous, high-definition imagery – 900 times the detail of Google Maps – about road conditions and the highways network. The company has developed this into revolutionary and IP-rich proprietary software, which can be imported into the asset management systems of highways network operators, local authorities, mapping companies, major utilities and other blue-chip fir

companies.name: GCI
companies.description: GCI is one of the UK’s leading managed service providers helping organisations evolve from traditional technology environments.

companies.name: Genflow
companies.description: Genflow works with influencers and content creators, to help them develop and launch their own platforms, where they can customise features, own their audiences and develop unique products, alongside Genflow's in-house team of specialists.

companies.name: Giggling Squid
companies.description: Giggling Squid is a UK-based chain of Thai restaurants. It serves simple, fresh Thai cuisine at lunch and dinner and also offers takeaway services across its restaurants.

companies.name: Glacier Energy
companies.description: BGF-backed Glacier Energy provides a range of products, services and engineered solutions to the industrial and energy markets.

companies.name: Global App Testing
companies.description: Global App Testing allows teams to test apps in over 105 countries with 40,000 vetted professionals using real devices in real environments.

companies.name: Gymbox
companies.description: Founded in 2003, Gymbox pioneered a new type of gym experience designed to inspire and entertain its members through vibrant interiors, bold and unusual exercise classes and nightly resident DJs.

companies.name: Hicomply
companies.description: BGF-backed Hicomply develops an ISMS (Information Security Management System) platform for automating and fast-tracking compliance.

companies.name: Horbury Group
companies.description: Horbury Group provides construction solutions to developers, building owners and main contractors, across the UK.

companies.name: hyble
companies.description: BGF has invested significant growth capital into Edinburgh-based hyble, an industry-leading marketing technology (martech) company.

companies.name: IFA
companies.description: Independent Forgings and Alloys (IFA) provides mission-critical components to a range of industries, including aerospace, defence and power.

companies.name: IQ Endoscopes
companies.description: IQ Endoscopes is a medical device business that's working to revolutionise the early diagnosis of cancers and gastro-intestinal conditions. Its team of clinical, medtech and engineering specialists are developing sustainable, single-use endoscopes, to better support clinicians and patients.

companies.name: It’s Fresh!
companies.description: BGF-backed It’s Fresh! develops tech solutions to extend the shelf life of fresh fruit and vegetables throughout the entire supply chain.

companies.name: Joe & Seph’s
companies.description: Joe & Seph’s popcorn is handmade at their kitchens in London by a team of pastry chefs, who ‘air-pop’ the kernels and use only natural ingredients. The range now comprises over 50 innovative flavours, from Chilli Chocolate and Salted Caramel, to Cheese on Toast and Gin & Tonic, earning the business more than 40 Great Taste awards.

companies.name: Jumpstart
companies.description: Jumpstart is a market-leading innovation funding specialist, which provides a complete service in claiming R&D tax credits and Patent Box tax relief.

companies.name: Juriba
companies.description: Juriba pioneered the first large enterprise project command and control platform, Dashworks, to deliver ongoing Evergreen IT and complex IT transformation programs for organisational end users and devices.

companies.name: Just Digital
companies.description: A print and marketing services provider specialising in web to print, large format, printing services, graphic design and storage and fulfilment.

companies.name: Keenan Recycling
companies.description: Keenan Recycling is a family-owned food waste collections specialist that was acquired by Biffa in 2024, following a successful UK expansion.

companies.name: Kick ICT
companies.description: Kick ICT provides a range of IT services, focusing on financial systems, data analytics, technical and cyber services, and communications solutions, as well as ongoing managed services and support across its range of service offerings.

companies.name: Kinomica
companies.description: Kinomica is a proteomic-data science and diagnostics company specialising in cell signalling. Kinomica offers KScanTM, a powerful suite of advanced proprietary bioinformatics and phosphoproteomics analytical methods that can provide direct activity measurements of multiple endogenous kinases and comprehensive cell signalling network coverage.

companies.name: Kooth
companies.description: Kooth plc is the longest-established digital mental health services provider in the UK, focusing on personalised support for children and young people (aged 10 to 25).

companies.name: M Squared Lasers
companies.description: M Squared is a leading developer of photonics and quantum technology systems, harnessing the power of light to drive society leading innovation. The company serves scientists, cutting-edge corporations and top universities.

companies.name: M-Flow
companies.description: M-Flow uses Magma's m-pipe® technology to deliver high accuracy flow measurement for water cut and phase fraction measurement in oilfield applications. It produces an innovative range of advanced meters that provide accurate, real-time data on the oil, gas and water content in flow lines, with no impact on production integrity and flow.

companies.name: Makers
companies.description: Makers are creating a new generation of tech talent who are skilled and ready for the changing world of work. Inspired by the idea of discovering and unlocking potential in people for the benefit of 21st-century business and society.

companies.name: Maxion Therapeutics
companies.description: Maxion Therapeutics is a drug discovery and biotech company, which is developing novel biologics via its proprietary technology platform.

companies.name: Media Zoo
companies.description: Media Zoo was established to help businesses communicate better with their customers, their colleagues and each other. With a proud heritage in prime time filmmaking and top class audience retention, the company is perfectly placed to help many of Britain’s biggest and best known businesses navigate the technical, retail and digital disruption of the last decade.

companies.name: Metpro
companies.description: BGF has invested £13m into Metpro, a high-growth manufacturer and distributor of cable management products, based in Birmingham.

companies.name: Miracle
companies.description: BGF-backed Miracle Design & Play is a leading designer and installer of children’s playgrounds, specialising in the UK housebuilding sector.

companies.name: Miss Group
companies.description: Miss Group is an international digital solutions business that provides a range of hosting-related services, predominately to SMEs, including web hosting, domain registration, site building, and email management.

companies.name: MOA
companies.description: Spun out from Oxford University’s Plant Sciences Department in 2017, MOA Technology is leading the evolution of ethical and collaborative crop protection to feed the world’s growing population efficiently, safely and sustainably. It was set up to address the challenge of increasing levels of weed resistance to herbicides, and the company has developed its own platforms for the discovery of sustain

companies.name: Molecular Products Group
companies.description: Molecular Products Group is a family-owned manufacturer of advanced chemistry-based products, specialising in breathable gases.

companies.name: Molson
companies.description: Molson provides a wide range of equipment for the construction industry and is one of the largest suppliers of Korean and Japanese built excavators in Europe.

companies.name: MorphCostumes
companies.description: Best known for its iconic Morphsuits, MorphCostumes (AFG Media) offers 1,200 varied costume designs to its global customer base.

companies.name: Moteefe
companies.description: Moteefe enables brands and retailers of all sizes to offer unique and personalised merchandisable products within minutes. Its end-to-end e-commerce solution manages the entire production and fulfilment of high-quality, on-demand, customised products, routed as close to the end-consumer as possible for cost and carbon reduction.

companies.name: My Property Box
companies.description: My Property Box is a Darlington-headquartered estate agency that specialises in residential lettings and sales across the North East.

companies.name: Myzone
companies.description: Myzone develops accurate wearable technology to provide engaging and motivational experiences, which support behavioural change to make exercise habits stick. Unlike other activity monitors, Myzone rewards effort not fitness, motivating everyone to work harder, and using a handicap system (based on a user's maximum heart rate) so members can compete with anyone on a level playing field.

companies.name: NanoSyrinx
companies.description: BGF-backed biotech startup NanoSyrinx is developing novel platform technology for the targeted intracellular delivery of biological molecules.

companies.name: Newett Homes
companies.description: BGF-backed Newett Homes is a family-owned housebuilder, with plans to deliver more than 400 high-quality homes per year across Yorkshire.

companies.name: NewGen
companies.description: BGF-backed media group NewGen (previously Kairos Group) is a leading social agency that aims to bridge the gap between brands and creators.

companies.name: Northern Building Plastics
companies.description: Northern Building Plastics is a specialist distributor of high-quality uPVC plastics and building products to trade customers. Led by co-founders, Judah Wilson and Richard Lindop, the business opened its first super depot in Leeds in 2010, followed by a second site successfully opened in Bolton in May 2018 on the back of strong growth and a proven model.

companies.name: NSS Group
companies.description: Formed after a merger of two BGF portfolio companies, High Access and Nationwide Window Cleaning, NSS Group is one of the largest independent facilities management services companies in the UK.

companies.name: Ocee International
companies.description: BGF-backed Ocee International manufactures commercial furniture, working with re-sellers, design and build consultants, and architects.

companies.name: Odro
companies.description: Odro is the UK’s leading video software provider to the recruitment industry. The Odro platform provides agencies with advanced interviewing, sales messaging and video content creation tools in one complete end-to-end solution.

companies.name: One Media iP Group
companies.description: One Media iP Group is a B2B and B2C digital content provider, exploiting intellectual property rights around music and video. The AIM-listed business specialises in acquiring and repackaging nostalgic music and TV programmes from recordings made over the last 90 years.

companies.name: Open Cosmos
companies.description: Open Cosmos enables simple integration of almost any sensor in its standardised modular satellites and provides a one-stop-shop service that includes launch and satellite operations.

companies.name: Operam
companies.description: BGF-backed Operam Education Group is a leading education recruitment specialist, operating across the Midlands and North of England.

companies.name: Orbital Education
companies.description: Orbital Education operates premium international schools for local and expat families looking to educate their children within an English-speaking, high-quality school environment. The schools specialise in the delivery of English national curriculum for children aged 2-18.

companies.name: Palmer Hargreaves
companies.description: Palmer Hargreaves is a full-service marketing agency, which has traditionally serviced clients in the automotive sector. During its lifetime, the business has expanded into Germany, Russia and China, and diversified its client list to include the B2B, agrochemical and financial services sectors.

companies.name: Paperchase
companies.description: BGF-backed Paperchase Accountancy is a trusted financial partner to thousands of restaurants, bars, pubs and high-profile hospitality brands.

companies.name: Parklands Group
companies.description: Parklands Group is one of the largest independent care home providers in the north of Scotland, and one of the first Scottish nursing providers to receive Investors in People status.

companies.name: Johnsons Aggregates
companies.description: Johnsons Aggregates is a recycler of incinerator bottom ash (IBA), which reduces the amount of waste going to landfill. The business extracts metals from the IBA and turns the residue into a quality aggregate suitable for the construction industry, thereby avoiding any material going to landfill.

companies.name: Pharmacy2U
companies.description: Pharmacy2U is an online mail order pharmacy, and the largest contracted NHS pharmacy in the UK. Patients are offered an online home delivery prescription service, an online doctor service and a range of health and well-being retail products.

companies.name: Plum Guide
companies.description: Plum Guide is an online platform with a collection of the world's most inspiring spaces and hosts. It helps guest find the best holiday homes and rentals, and helps hosts get recognised and rewarded. The company uses a mix of algorithms and physical visits by hospitality experts to shortlist and select Plum-approved spaces.

companies.name: Proventeq
companies.description: BGF-backed Proventeq is a digital transformation specialist that supports businesses across a range of technology areas.

companies.name: Puraffinity
companies.description: BGF-backed Puraffinity develops precision technology for the removal of toxic PFAS 'forever chemicals' from water.

companies.name: PureCyber
companies.description: One of the fastest-growing technology companies in Wales, BGF-backed PureCyber is a global leader in managed cybersecurity solutions for SMEs.
